title: The price of power
summary: Why the hunters who last longest drift toward madness.

claims.text: A hunter's early months are torment, and many do not survive them: they fall to beasts, become puppets of manipulators, or take their own lives.

Those who endure, held by a grudge, deep sorrow and forgiveness, or a lofty vision, go deeper into the hunt and show new and stranger edges; whether these come as reward or as tools, the Messengers do not say.
Immersion in the hunt pulls hunters away from who they were, and the most steadfast and capable tend toward madness as their minds and identities erode.
Hunters at this extreme seem erratic, driven by aims lesser hunters cannot follow, and can end up as foes of other imbued when goals clash.
